items.title: Janis Siegel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 2015
items.q: Till Bronner is a German trumpet player whose music I really like.

ctx.x: To do whatever kind of project you wanted. A dream project. Do you have one?

I could construct one if you give me like a half hour. I could. Oh yeah. There’s musicians all over. I would do like a world music record I think, off the top of my head. There’s a lot of musicians throughout the world that I really love, and I’m very curious about all the different styles there are. And I’d like to bring a little of myself into those styles. I mean that’s what my Brazilian project is about. So I mean there’s a Vietnamese guitarist that I love who lives in Paris. I can’t pronounce his name —…
It’s funny you say that because you’re a food blogger, right?
